title: Surface Mount Multilayer Ceramic Chip Capacitors (SMD MLCCs), KC-LINK for Fast Switching Semiconductor Applications, DC Link, Snubber, Resonator Capacitor, 150 C (C1039_KC-LINK_C0G, 3/12/2021); numeric ripple table from the 2/23/2018 edition
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Values not stated numerically in text/tables are null. volume_cm3 and A_per_uF are derived here (box l*w*h or cylinder pi/4*D^2*L from the stated max dimensions; A_per_uF = I_rms_A / C_uF), not datasheet values. Distributor-hosted copies (components.ru 2021 edition; Mouser 2018 edition). Voltages 500/650/1000/1200/1700/2000 V; no 700 V class. The 2021 edition gives ripple current only as graphs ('peak capacitor temperature of 150 C'); the 2018 edition (500 V, 220 nF, 3640 only) has a numeric typical table copied into I_rms_table (400 V bias, 105 C) and extra fields. I_rms_A/I_rms_f_kHz for CKC33C224 = lowest tabulated frequency (50 kHz) at 400 V bias, 105 C; nothing at 25 kHz. Capacitance vs DC bias: text says only 'no capacitance shift with voltage' / 'no change in capacitance versus DC voltage' (chart axis +-10 %), no numeric values -> C_bias_uF null. 650 V single-chip maximum is 150 nF per the 2021 Farnell overview (the Mouser product brief says 220 nF; not resolved). DF 0.1 % max, TCC +-30 ppm/C, DWV 750 V for 500 V parts.

conditions.I_rms: see per-item; 2018 table: typical, T_cap peak 150 C, heat-sink mounted, no forced air
